economic_thesis: Asset-specific volatility compression reflects temporarily balanced crypto inventories. A release accompanied by broad cross-sectional dispersion is more likely to persist, while a release without broad participation is more likely to converge. Conditioning continuation versus convergence on dispersion should create complementary long and short roles without relying on unconditional momentum.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Negative dispersion expansions should make the short sleeve the primary contributor while residualization limits a uniform beta short.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Positive dispersion expansions should reward strong long releases; shorts act as relative-weakness hedges.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Low-dispersion failed releases are faded on both sides, with the combined portfolio expected to be positive.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Own positive releases during dispersion expansion and oversold failed releases during convergence.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Own negative releases during dispersion expansion and overbought failed releases during convergence.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Follow genuine idiosyncratic breaks but rely on no-leverage volatility targeting, stops, and drawdown brakes to reduce tail exposure.

falsifier: Reject this exact no-control core unless net Sharpe is at least 0.75, annualized return is positive, Calmar is at least 0.40, maximum drawdown is at most 0.30, doubled-cost Sharpe is at least 0.35, doubled-cost return is positive, trial-adjusted probability positive is at least 0.90, at least four of six folds are profitable, and positive-quarter fraction is at least 0.55. Also require positive bull, bear, and chop return and Sharpe, at least three positive regime Sharpes, worst-regime Sharpe at least -0.25, positive long-bull, short-bear, and combined-chop attribution, both sleeves above every official exposure/activity/notional floor, at least 70% profitable declared neighbors with median neighbor Sharpe at least 0.50, positive-PnL concentration at most 0.40, complete scheduled A5 score coverage, positive pooled score IC, and at least four positive fold ICs. Compression and dispersion ablations remain mechanism evidence, never rescue evidence.
mechanism: Cross-sectionally residualize closed 8h returns; require prior idiosyncratic volatility compression; score the new release as continuation when cross-sectional dispersion expands and as convergence when dispersion stays subdued; form capped, balanced long and short sleeves once daily.
risk_policy_plan: Run the center first with root no-control risk_policy.json. Volatility-target-only, drawdown-only, position-stop-only, time-stop-only, turnover-only, and combined policies remain dormant unless that core passes every official central-development, regime, role, sleeve, stability, concentration, A5 coverage, and score-IC gate. Controls cannot rescue failure. Before any later policy commit, registration, and run, copy its immutable risk_policies template byte-for-byte to root risk_policy.json because the lifecycle reads only that path.
selection_metric: First require every non-compensatory development gate. Among passers, maximize the minimum bull/bear/chop net Sharpe, then doubled-cost Sharpe, then minimize drawdown and one-way turnover.

economic_thesis: After coin-specific volatility compresses relative to its own prior baseline, a persistent idiosyncratic three-bar shock can reflect a temporary inventory displacement rather than durable common-market information. Requiring multi-bar direction agreement and penalizing rough paths should isolate dislocations that recoil over the next week, while per-bar median residualization and an exactly neutral book remove a common crypto-direction forecast.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Long recently oversold compressed-shock coins and short recently overbought peers without taking positive market beta.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Short overextended positive idiosyncratic shocks and own negative dislocations while exact neutrality avoids a disguised bull bet.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Inventory-driven cross-sectional overshoots should recoil most directly; combined-chop attribution must still be positive empirically.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Own the strongest returned recoil scores generated by durable negative residual shocks after compression.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short the lowest returned recoil scores generated by durable positive residual shocks after compression.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Weekly turnover, 0.36 gross, eight or more names per side, and a 0.025 cap limit scale; profitability remains a noncompensatory empirical gate.

falsifier: Reject if this exact no-control core fails any official central-development threshold: net Sharpe at least 0.75, positive annualized return, Calmar at least 0.40, maximum drawdown at most 0.30, doubled-cost Sharpe at least 0.35, positive doubled-cost return, trial-adjusted probability positive at least 0.90, at least four of six profitable folds, positive-quarter fraction at least 0.55, worst-regime Sharpe at least -0.25, and at least three positive regime Sharpes. Also require strictly positive return and Sharpe in bull, bear, and chop; positive long-bull, short-bear, and combined-chop attribution; both sleeves use the 0.01 active-exposure threshold and have active-bar fraction at least 0.10, mean gross exposure at least 0.01, and executed notional at least 1000 USDT; at least 70% of declared neighbors profitable with median neighbor Sharpe at least 0.50; positive-PnL concentration at most 0.40; complete scheduled A5 score coverage; positive pooled score IC; and at least four positive fold ICs. Controls, neighbors, ablations, private data, and sign inversion cannot rescue any failure.
mechanism: Every seven days, subtract the same-bar pure-crypto median from each of 126 completed 8-hour returns. Compare 21 pre-shock bars with the prior 84-bar volatility baseline; score the latest three-bar idiosyncratic shock in the opposite direction only after two-of-three sign agreement, median-component durability, and path-roughness shrinkage; final-rank once at A5; construct a broad equal-dollar exactly neutral 0.36-gross book from only returned scores.
risk_policy_plan: Run only the exact disabled no-control first-pivot reference. Declared neighbors remain dormant until it passes every non-neighborhood official and stricter gate, then run solely to adjudicate stability. No risk control, stop, private ticket, or submission is authorized until the complete gate passes. Controls cannot repair a failed mechanism.
selection_metric: Noncompensatory eligibility first: every no-control, regime, role, sleeve, stability, concentration, A5 coverage, and score-IC gate must pass.
